title: fix(record-page): the related tab offers only open-in-list and one add entry; a multi-pick add is all or none
body:
Part of #35601

Fixes #35710

Part of #35590

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：记录详情页的关联页签只剩「↗」和「+ 添加」两个入口（普通关联的选择框只列出还没挂在任何记录下的子记录，不会悄悄把别处的记录改挂过来），一次选多条要么全部加上、要么一条不加；带状态的子记录按状态分组，已完成的排在最后；从「↗」打开的列表会写明来自哪条记录，可一键重置回去；明细表货币算不出来时合计照样显示金额。
- 为什么做：记录详情页子卡（关联页签只保留开列表与添加两件事），并顺带补上明细表合计缺失的子卡。
- 出错会怎样：一次选多条时如果其中一条失败，整批都不加并在列表下方显示服务端原话；目前这句话不一定点名是哪一条，这一半留在原卡等维护者定夺；改动只在界面层，直接撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。「批量添加失败时点名具体哪一条」已另开 #35726（给批量接口的报错加上第几条），本单合并后排队。

## What changes

**The related tab (`RelatedList.tsx`, the enlarged face).** The toolbar draws two entries at its right end: 「↗」 (`data-related-open-list`, the host's `onViewAll`) and 「+ 添加」 (`data-related-add`). The filter box, the 全部/我的/逾期 chips, the export, the tab's own New and the count line under the table are gone; the count lives in the tab title. A page's declared toolbar actions for the child (`toolbarActions`) still draw beside the two entries: they are authored metadata, not tab chrome, and dropping them would silently lose an authored action (see Acceptance notes).

**One add entry, chosen by the relationship** when the page authored no `add` (`derivedAddOf`):

| child relationship | 「+ 添加」 opens |
|---|---|
| `lookup` | a picker of the child object, listing only UNLINKED children (this relationship empty); its first row is New (`createRow`) |
| `master_detail` whose rows name a catalog record (exactly one other required, single, editable `lookup`) | a picker of that catalog; a pick creates a row naming it (`linkField`) |
| `master_detail` with no catalog | the new-record form, linked to this record (the host's `onNew`) |

An authored `add` keeps its own picker and its own `picker.filter`, as before.

**No silent re-parent (seat ruling on L1-a S1).** The derived lookup picker filters `<relationship> is_empty`: a child already under this record (a no-op pick) and a child under another parent (which a pick would move without notice) are not offered. Moving a child between parents stays on the child's own form, where the change is visible.

**All or none.** A pick of N records is ONE `dataSource.batchTransaction` call: one `POST /api/v1/batch` with `atomic: true` (ADR-0035, ADR-0119 D4), never a client loop. Re-parenting a lookup child is `update`, a catalog pick is `create`. On failure nothing is added, the picker closes and the server's own message shows under the list (`role="alert"`). A data source with no `batchTransaction` offers no picker (it falls back to New). This also changes an authored `add` picker everywhere it is used: it was a loop of single writes, it is now the same one batch.

**Status grouping.** On the related tab a child is grouped by status when it has a status select (`detectStatusField`) AND a `dueLike` date whose `settledWhen` the status settles. The rule, generic and declared, not a name list: a status option is "completed" exactly when `isDeadlineSettled(deadline, { [status]: option })` is true. Open options come first in the order the select declares them, then rows with no status (「—」), then the completed options; empty groups are not drawn; each group header collapses its rows. No settling option ⇒ no groups (the list draws as before).

**Remembered header sort and column widths.** Per list (`CHILD.FK`), in the record page's existing per-user preference row (`sys_user_preference` `ui.record.PARENT`, through `RecordPagePreferencesContext`, which gains an optional `relatedLists` slice); no new storage. The sort is applied once on first read; a header click is written back. Column order and widths ride `object-grid`'s existing `columnState` input and `onColumnStateChange` host prop.

**「↗」 on empty lists and body tables.** The card face draws 「↗」 on an empty list and on a body table too (when the host offers a destination).

**The list 「↗」 opens knows its record** (`RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx`, `ObjectDataPage.tsx`). The bridge appends this record to the record trail (`?from=`) of the URL it already built (`filter[FK]=ID`). The list page then names the record in the condition's tag (「Account Globex ×」, the merged tag reused), draws a breadcrumb (object / record / this list), offers 「Reset」 which puts the sourced condition back after the reader changed or removed filters, and opens New as that record's child (the record form overlay with `formLink`, the related list's own New path). The condition itself stays an ordinary URL filter.

**Body-table totals with no resolvable currency (the folded card).** A currency column whose currency resolves to nothing (no code of its own, no tenant default) now totals: the server's figure, drawn as its cells are (two places, no symbol). Before, the total was left out. Record-mode amounts whose rows name their own currency keep the per-currency grouping (a mixed or unknown code still draws no total).

**`RecordPickerDialog`** gains an optional `createRow` prop (a dashed first row). Columns and search are untouched.

No new i18n key: the strings reuse `detail.add`, `detail.new`, `detail.viewAll`, `common.reset`. The keys the removed chips used (`relatedFilter`, `relatedChips`, `relatedChipAll/Mine/Overdue`, `relatedExport`, `relatedRows`) are now unread and left in the packs (see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

Migrated and retired:

- `RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524.test.tsx`: rewritten. Retired the chip, filter, export and in-tab New cases and the export describe; new pins: exactly ↗ and Add (also on an empty list); lookup picker with New first and three picks as ONE batch of three; a rejected batch adds nothing, shows the reason and sends no single write; master_detail with a catalog creates rows naming the catalog; master_detail without one calls New; no batch route ⇒ no picker; status groups in order and collapsible, with a control; the header sort written to and read from the record-page preference.
- `RelatedList.enlargedListGrid-28865.test.tsx`: retired the filter-box DEVIATION pin and the two chip-count pins; added "the count is not repeated under the grid", column state read from and written to the preference, and a no-store control.
- `RecordRelatedListRenderer.showViewAll-12741.test.tsx`: 「an EMPTY list: no link」 migrated to 「an EMPTY list: ↗ still draws」.
- `RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx`: 「…and not at all without one」 split; new pin: with no currency resolving the total is the server figure, no symbol, one ungrouped aggregate.
- Add tests given a `batchTransaction` on their data source (the picker gate now needs it): `addGateDataSource`, `addGrant-12082`, `addPickerFilter`, `addPickerGuard`, `addPickerLabelField`, `record-blocks.nestedLabelsI18nLabel-10993`.

New: `ObjectDataPage.sourceList-35601.test.tsx` (tag names the record, breadcrumb, Reset, New linked, a no-trail control, `sourceRelationshipField`); a `from` pin in `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.viewAll-12741.test.tsx`; a `relatedLists` sanitize pin in `RecordPreferencesProvider-25883.test.tsx`.

<details><summary>Fixes after 6ea1cb96 (CI)</summary>

- df21125d: dropped the unused `isPermissionError` import (Lint UI); the related tab entry's `detail.add` fallback is written once (`addFallbackLabel`), so the residue pin stays at 4 sites, and its comment names the new entry.
- 05a187d4: `batch.call(dataSource, …)` hid the add from the affordance write census (`affordanceGrantMap-12082`); it now calls `ds.batchTransaction(operations)` directly, and the census has one `handleAddRecords :: batch` site mapped to `relatedNew` + `relatedRowEdit` (replacing the old `create` / `update` pair).
- CI at 05a187d4: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed.
- e62ce9e7 (seat ruling on L1-a S1): the derived lookup picker filters the relationship to empty; new pin in `RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524`: a row linked here and a row linked elsewhere are absent, the unlinked row is present, and every picker read carries the rule.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Open decision: naming the failed item.** Measured on a live boot: `POST /api/v1/batch` with `atomic: true` answers a failing op with ONE error (`404 {"error":"Record ID not found in showcase_contact","code":"RECORD_NOT_FOUND",...}`) and no op index. The list shows that message, which names the record only when the server's own message does (here it does; a validation error such as a missing required field does not). Naming the item in every case needs the batch route to say which op failed (a `batch-routes.ts` widening, Clause-② yes) or a data-source door over the per-object atomic batch (`/data/OBJECT/batch`, which reports per row). Neither was made here: the op index is filed as #35726 (nested under #35601), which is why the body says Part of for the related-tab card.
- **Fence readings, declared:** `RecordPickerDialog` gains `createRow` (the fence names its columns and search; neither changed). `RecordPagePreferencesContext` (react) and `RecordPreferencesProvider` (app-shell) gain the `relatedLists` slice: the ruling's per-user mechanism, no new storage. `ObjectDataPage.tsx` carries the list route's tag, breadcrumb and reset wiring (the claim's "list route wiring"); `useOpenRecordList.ts` needed no change.
- **Kept, not removed:** a page's declared `toolbarActions` for the child still draw beside ↗ and Add (authored metadata, not tab chrome).
- **Not added:** auto-filling a catalog row's same-named fields (description, unit price) on a picker add; the server's defaults and hooks apply. 「Reset」 rewrites the URL filters; a quick-filter selection inside the list view is read from the URL only on first mount.
- **Seen on the list page, not touched (list-page internals are out of this card):** the list view's own locked chip repeats the sourced condition with the raw id (「Account: = 3zKQ…」) under the named tag, and the list view's own 「Reset」 sits under this page's 「Reset」 (screenshot 06).
- The "master_detail with no catalog" entry opens the new-record form linked to the record (the ruling's "add a row directly"); it does not insert an inline blank row.
- The removed chips' i18n keys are left in the packs, unread.
- No platform-checklist item changed: `records-forms.related-list-server-pagination` still holds (paging kept on the tab).

## Verification

Two-minute check: on the CRM example, open an opportunity, its Activities tab: two buttons at the right (↗, Add), activities grouped Planned / In Progress / Cancelled / Completed. Open the Line Items body table: the Total row shows amounts with no currency symbol.

Browser reading (A4): built console (`pnpm console:build` at this branch), headless Chromium 1440x900 at DSF 2; screenshots in the seat's `a4-35601` folder.

<details><summary>A4 readings</summary>

- Showcase, account Globex, Contacts tab (lookup, empty): toolbar `["View All","Add"]` (01). Add opens a picker of contacts, first row New (02). Three picks, Confirm: ONE `POST /api/v1/batch` 200 with three `update` ops and `atomic: true`; tab title Contacts 3 (03, 04).
- Failing case: three more picked, the third deleted before Confirm: ONE `POST /api/v1/batch` 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`; the alert shows the server message; the account still has 3 contacts and the first two picks kept their old account (05).
- ↗ round trip: the list opens at `.../showcase_contact/data?filter[account]=ID&from=[{o,i,t:"Globex"}]`; tag 「Account Globex」, breadcrumb 「Accounts (Success Overlay) / Globex / Contacts」, Reset disabled (06); tag removed, Reset enabled (07); Reset puts `filter[account]` back (08); New opens the Create Contact overlay with `formLink=account:ID` (09); the breadcrumb record link returns to the account page.
- CRM, opportunity Initech Expansion, Activities tab: groups `planned, in_progress, cancelled` open and `completed` settled, in that order (11, 12 collapsed).
- CRM line items (master_detail, product is text, no catalog): enlarged toolbar `["View All","Add"]`; Add opens the new-record form (`form=new&formObject=crm_opportunity_line_item&formLink=opportunity:ID`), no picker (15, 16). Body table total row 「Total 2,649.75 5,501.00」, cells 「999.00」, 「3,601.50」: no symbol, as the cells (14).
- The CRM line-item add-3 case does not exist as filed: the CRM line item has no catalog, so its Add is the form; the add-3 and failing cases were read on the showcase Contacts tab instead.

</details>
